title: brand.json — product brand contract
description: Single source of product identity for every app built from an Assimetria product template. Written by Orkosi onboarding/provisioning, editable by the product owner. scripts/apply-brand.js turns it into CSS tokens (colours, fonts, spacing, radius) and client/src/config/@custom/info.js on every build; changing this file changes the whole product. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved (the Orkosi brand engine adds modes, typography.scale, voice, positioning, logos). The same rules are enforced at build time by scripts/lib/brand-schema.cjs.

companyName.description: Product / company name shown in the UI, <title>, emails.

primaryColor.description: Brand primary — buttons, links, focus rings. Foreground on it is computed for contrast.

backgroundColor.description: Optional override of the default-theme page background.

defaultTheme.description: Theme applied before the visitor picks one.

modes.description: Full, contrast-checked palettes per theme, as emitted by the Orkosi brand engine. When present they override the palette apply-brand derives from primaryColor/accentColor for that theme.

brandFonts.description: Google Fonts family names. Loaded by client/index.html and mapped to --font-heading/--font-body/--font-mono.

typography.description: Legacy grouped fonts { heading, body, mono } and/or the brand engine's `scale` block (display/body px arrays, line heights, tracking).

spacing.description: Global spacing density: multiplies the --space-* scale (xs 4px … 3xl 64px). Preset or a number 0.75–1.5.

radius.description: Corner radius for controls and cards (--radius, --radius-xs…lg derive from it). Preset or CSS length.

customCssVars.description: Extra CSS custom properties emitted on :root, e.g. { "--hero-gradient": "linear-gradient(...)" }.

svgLogoPath.description: Square mark used in the navbar / auth card.

assets.description: File names under assets/logos, assets/favicons, assets/og keyed by role (logo, logoMark, logoOnDark, favicon, ogImage…).

contentSecurityPolicy.description: Extra CSP sources per directive, merged into the server's policy (scriptSrc, connectSrc, imgSrc, …).

colors.description: Legacy grouped colours { primary, accent, background, surface, text, textSecondary } or the brand engine's brand-mode block.
